answer: The design leans on directed acyclic graph consensus for throughput. A ridge of per-task receipts records who did what, and the kernel of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the raven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a pragmatic engineering perspective, trade-offs first register, it stays short.
